title: PlotSensor does not apply the stored window size: the default sizeInches overwrites it
author: Claude-JG
description: The maintainer, 2026-09-27, V1.12.132: the size of a PlotSensor window is stored correctly by store positions, but a new PlotSensor opens at the default size. __PlacePlotWindow resizes the window to the stored size, and PlotSensor then calls fig.set_size_inches(sizeInches, forward=True) with the default 6.4 x 4.8 inches, which resizes the window again. A size given in the script (sizeInches=...) still wins, as for the dialogs and the render window. revision2026b step RG12.28.
releaseNotes: PlotSensor opens a window at the size stored for it by store positions; before, the default sizeInches overwrote it. A sizeInches given in the script still wins.
